⚠️ Traffic Advisory – Claremont Access Closed (Both Directions)

The Claremont Access is temporarily closed in both directions due to extremely icy road conditions. Several vehicles have become stuck and crews are currently working to clear them from the roadway.

Hamilton Police are on scene, and the City of Hamilton has been notified and is dispatching salt trucks to treat the road.

Please avoid the Claremont Access and use alternate routes until further notice. We will provide updates as the situation improves.

#HamOnt

Traffic Advisory

Traffic arrangements will be in place on 14 March 2026 (02:00 PM – 10:00 PM) in view of the “Honey Singh Live in Delhi” concert at Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium.

Traffic movement is likely to remain affected on IP Marg (MGM Road), Vikas Marg & Ring Road (Rajghat to IP Depot) due to the arrival of spectators.

Commuters are advised to plan their journey in advance, avoid the affected stretches & follow traffic advisories for a smooth travel experience.

#DPTrafficAdvisory
